other_conditions: Must be a Micro, Small, or Medium Enterprise engaged in manufacturing activities
Must be set up in the State of Kerala
Must be an independent legal entity
Must have filed Entrepreneurs Memorandum Part I/II with the respective General Manager, District Industries Centre
Must pay the requisite application fee of ₹1105 per unit
Must provide true information and allow verification/inspection of plant, machinery and other assets
Must execute the required legal agreement online (and on paper if required) and furnish a signed hard copy
Must use the assistance only for the agreed purposes and operate the unit as stipulated
Must submit annual documents (balance sheets, valid local‑body licence, electricity bills, performance particulars) each year till 31 December of the next financial year
Enterprises belonging to listed priority sectors may receive additional assistance
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to ₹40 lakh (15‑25% of capital investment) plus additional 10% incentives for priority‑sector enterprises, certain districts, and new‑technology adoption.
documents_required: Original copies of any important documents as required
Copies of invoices of machinery (for technology support)
Proof of payment to research institutions
Valuation certificate of Mechanical Engineer or Chartered Engineer
Certificate from research institution confirming new technology
